content:
We have functional groups list includes "ketones", "C-C triple bonds". Good.

Now search templates with criteria: functional_groups_broken includes ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"]; functional_groups_formed maybe none? In forward reaction, these groups are lost, so broken. Bonds formed: "6-6" (C-C single). Bonds broken: "6-8" (C-O single). Need to know bond types: 6-6 is single between two sp3 carbons? In SMILES, bond types: 6-6 for single between two carbons, 6-8 for single between carbon (6) and oxygen (8). So we can set bonds_formed=["6-6"], bonds_broken=["6-8"].

Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with those.
